upstreamServerUrl.description: Upstream server this instance sends its data to

mode.description: request: the upstream server decides which outbreaks it receives; legacy: it receives the outbreaks without a request (older versions / keys of the mobile app)

outbreaks.description: Outbreaks of this instance and the decision of the upstream server: {outbreakId, name, status, decidedAt}

checkedAt.description: Last time the decisions were retrieved from the upstream server

requestedAt.description: Last time this instance asked to send outbreaks

error.description: Why the decisions couldn't be retrieved the last time

errorCode.description: Why the upstream server couldn't be reached / didn't accept the credentials (e.g. CONNECTION_REFUSED, INVALID_CREDENTIALS)
